parsed.name: 罗德与施瓦茨 NRVS 功率计
parsed.description: 用于射频/微波功率测量的台式功率计，可读取测量频率、功率幅度、传感器信息以及校准相关数据，适合实验室中的功率检测与传感器校验管理。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop RF/microwave power meter for power measurement. It can read or set measurement frequency and query power amplitude, sensor information, and calibration-related data for laboratory power measurement and sensor verification workflows.

actions.description_en: Get or set the measurement frequency.

actions.description: 读取当前功率幅度测量值。
actions.description_en: Read the current power amplitude measurement.

actions.description: 读取已连接功率传感器的信息。
actions.description_en: Read information about the connected power sensor.
